description: One segment of a SegmentedControl: identified by value, labelled label (the accessible name; shown visibly unless icon is given, which then shows alone).

constructors.description: A segment for value, shown as label or, when given, icon alone.

params.name: label
params.description: The segment's label: its accessible name always, and its visible content unless icon is given.

params.name: icon
params.description: Shown alone instead of label; label still names it for screen readers.
